To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the institutional culture of the University of isfahan has effects on the knowledge creation of its faculty members.
institutional culture and its variables have significant effect on the knowledge creation of faculty members of the university of Isfahan.

the orientation towards social behavior has the most effects on the amount and the type of knowledge creation of faculty members and this variable can be considered as the main predictor of knowledge creation.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the effects of institutional culture on knowledge creation and its components in the University of Isafhan.
investigating the effects of institutional culture on knowledge creation in universities.
investigating the effects of institutional culture on the amount of creation of knowledge of faculty members.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
institutional culture is one of the most influential factors in creating knowledge in universities and its effect on knowledge creation of faculty members is significant.
orientation toward social behaviors has the most effects on the knowledge creation of faculty members and the least effect is related to the dimension of "orientation towards social behaviors".
the more the faculty members of Isfahan University are oriented towards social behavior and social interaction, the more they create knowledge.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the results of this study indicate that the more the faculty members are oriented toward social behavior and the more the institutional culture of the university is oriented to social behavior, the more knowledge is created by the faculty members.

in order to promote knowledge creation, the orientation towards social behavior of the faculty members must be increased and this is possible if the faculty members have a sense of belongingness to their institution, they are committed to their work and they have a high level of trust in their colleagues.
the faculty members of universities should pay attention to their institutional culture in the way that the amount of knowledge created by them is more than the present level.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the university should pay more attention to its organizational culture in order to increase the level of knowledge creation of its members.
the more the orientation towards social behavior in the institutional culture of a university, the more the faculty members will create knowledge.
the more the orientation of the faculty members towards social behavior, the more the amount of knowledge created by them.
